## About
The Break started out as a billiard hall. Pinball and video games all grew up here, and over time billiards took the back seat as the world changed. Then food was added, and things only get better every day.
Today you'll find music based rhythm games, shooters, fighting games, a pinball lineup we keep rotating, regulation Brunswick pool tables and a snack bar. The games run on quarters, the way they always have.
Neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating across 565 Google reviews. Come in with the kids and see why.

## Services
- The Arcade: Rhythm games, shooters and fighting games, all on quarters. No tokens, no cards to load up.
- Pinball: A great selection of pinball machines, with new ones rotated in all the time.
- Billiards: The Break started as a billiard hall, and we still keep regulation Brunswick tables.
- The Snack Bar: Home of the Break Steak, plus appetizers, ice cream desserts and milk shakes.

## FAQ
Q: How do the games work?
A: The games take quarters. One reviewer put it simply: traditional quarters, no hourly rates.

Q: What are your hourly rates for the tables?
A: Our rates are only $7.25 per hour for 2 players.

Q: Is The Break a good spot for kids?
A: We're a family fun center. One reviewer said the owner was genuinely kind when they brought their kids, and another appreciated how welcoming it was for their son.

Q: What's good to eat?
A: The Break Steak is what we're known for. The snack bar also has appetizers, ice cream desserts and milk shakes.

Q: How do I get in touch?
A: Send us a message through the contact form on our website and we will try to get back to you within 24 hours.

## What customers say
- "Went to Eight in the Break for a birthday party and the vibes are straight-up old-school arcade nostalgia — neon lights, games everywhere, just fun from the moment you walk in.

But listen… the REAL gem here? THE FOOD.

My husband grabbed a cheesesteak combo — fries and drink included — for six dollars (yes, $6 in 2025!!). We also ordered two chicken tender baskets with fries to share, and it was MORE than enough food.

And the flavor? No words. Legit some of the best food we’ve ever had. Everything was fresh, hot, seasoned perfectly, and honestly way better than places that cost triple the price.

I would 100% come back just for the food alone — pull up, order, grab it to go… whatever. It’s THAT good.

Totally worth the trip. Totally five stars. 🙌🍟🔥

Kathy 🪷🩵" (PURE BUTTER MELTS, 5/5)
- "This arcade is awesome, no gimmicks, no overpriced tokens, no proprietary cards you have to load up, and no expensive wristbands. Just good old-fashioned quarters. You can use the same change for the parking meter and the games.

The food is reasonably priced, the kitchen is open and spotless, the owner was genuinely kind when I brought my kids. They had a blast hopping from game to game. My only small suggestion: add those disposable sanitizing wipes like gyms have, so players can wipe down the machines.

Other than that, we loved every minute and I have a feeling this will become one of our go-to spots for family fun days." (W A, 5/5)
- "Great family-friendly atmosphere with a diverse mix of pinball, shooting, and dance games. We particularly appreciated how welcoming the environment was for my son. The service at the food counter was excellent, and the pricing is very reasonable; $20 provided nearly an hour of play for the whole family. While I’d love to see more vintage arcade titles, the current quarter-operated setup is convenient and nostalgic. Highly recommended for a fun, affordable afternoon." (Fred Barnetas, 5/5)
- "Been going here for over 10 years at this point. Fantastic to see this place grow, thrive and still provide good service and unique experiences in a time of redemption nonsense.

Fantastic to see the break steak is still going strong, and especially for the price you can’t compete." (James Pan, 5/5)
- "Walked in here for the first time today. Traditional quarters with no hourly rates and a great atmosphere. Support the small businesses. Go here before the big time places. It is well worth your quarters! Nostalgia to the max!" (D N, 5/5)
